mapper.select: SELECT task.* FROM deletion_task task JOIN material m ON m.id = task.material_id WHERE task.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY') AND task.not_before <= #{now} AND task.lifecycle_generation = m.lifecycle_generation AND m.lifecycle_state IN ('DELETE_PENDING', 'DELETING') ORDER BY task.not_before, task.created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE deletion_task SET status = #{task.status}, attempt = #{task.attempt}, lease_owner = #{task.leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{task.leaseUntil}, fence_token = #{task.fenceToken}, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{task.id} AND fence_token = #{expectedFenceToken} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM deletion_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND stage = #{expectedStage} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND fence_token = #{expectedFenceToken} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence_read_lease lease JOIN material_version v ON v.id = lease.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND lease.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lease.expires_at > #{now}
SELECT * FROM material WHERE id = #{materialId} AND lifecycle_generation = #{lifecycleGeneration} AND lifecycle_state IN ('DELETE_PENDING', 'DELETING') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO deleted_source_tombstone (material_id, version_id, version_no, deleted_at, reason_code, former_citation_count) SELECT v.material_id, v.id, v.version_no, #{deletedAt}, 'MATERIAL_PERMANENTLY_DELETED', COUNT(DISTINCT ce.citation_id) FROM material_version v LEFT JOIN citation_evidence ce ON ce.version_id = v.id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} GROUP BY v.material_id, v.id, v.version_no

INSERT IGNORE INTO citation_source_tombstone (id, citation_id, opaque_material_id, opaque_version_id, version_no, deleted_at, state) SELECT CONCAT('cst_', LEFT(SHA2(CONCAT(ce.citation_id, ':', v.id), 256), 60)), ce.citation_id, v.material_id, v.id, v.version_no, #{deletedAt}, 'SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' FROM citation_evidence ce JOIN material_version v ON v.id = ce.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} GROUP BY ce.citation_id, v.material_id, v.id, v.version_no
mapper.update: UPDATE source_citation citation SET citation.state = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM citation_evidence live WHERE live.citation_id = citation.id) THEN 'PARTIAL_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' ELSE 'SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' END WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM citation_source_tombstone tombstone WHERE tombstone.citation_id = citation.id AND tombstone.opaque_material_id = #{materialId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_deletion_proof (material_id, lifecycle_generation, tombstoned_citation_count) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{lifecycleGeneration}, #{tombstoneCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE lifecycle_generation = VALUES(lifecycle_generation), tombstoned_citation_count = GREATEST(tombstoned_citation_count, VALUES(tombstoned_citation_count))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT projection.index_name, projection.namespace, projection.vector_id FROM retrieval_chunk_vector_projection projection JOIN retrieval_chunk chunk ON chunk.id = projection.retrieval_chunk_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = chunk.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND projection.provider_deleted_at IS NULL

= blob.id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND blob.original_object_version_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_version other WHERE other.content_blob_id = blob.id AND material_revision_artifact artifact JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = artifact.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', artifact.object_key, artifact.object_version_id FROM material_visual_artifact artifact JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = artifact.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', e.display_text_object_key, e.display_text_object_version_id FROM evidence_unit e JOIN material_version v ON v.id = e.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND e.display_text_object_version_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', e.visual_object_key, e.visual_object_version_id FROM evidence_unit e JOIN material_version v ON v.id = e.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND e.visual_object_version_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', e.visual_analysis_object_key, e.visual_analysis_object_version_id FROM evidence_unit e JOIN material_version v ON v.id = e.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND e.visual_analysis_object_version_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', chunk.retrieval_text_object_key, chunk.retrieval_text_object_version_id FROM retrieval_chunk chunk JOIN material_version v ON v.id = chunk.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', chunk.parent_context_object_key, chunk.parent_context_object_version_id FROM retrieval_chunk chunk JOIN material_version v ON v.id = chunk.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND chunk.parent_context_object_version_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', manifest.object_key, manifest.object_version_id FROM retrieval_projection_manifest manifest JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = manifest.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', batch.vector_object_key, batch.vector_object_version_id FROM retrieval_vector_batch batch JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = batch.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND batch.vector_object_version_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'MATERIALS', r.gap_manifest_key, r.gap_manifest_object_version_id FROM material_processing_revision r upload.quarantine_object_version_id FROM material_upload_session upload WHERE upload.material_id = #{materialId} AND upload.quarantine_bucket IS NOT NULL AND upload.quarantine_key IS NOT NULL AND upload.quarantine_object_version_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE material_deletion_proof SET deleted_vector_count = deleted_vector_count + #{deletedCount}, vectors_deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, request_ids_hash = SHA2(CONCAT(COALESCE(request_ids_hash, ''), ':', #{requestIdsHash}), 256) WHERE material_id = #{materialId}

UPDATE material_deletion_proof SET deleted_object_count = #{deletedCount}, objects_deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, request_ids_hash = SHA2(CONCAT(COALESCE(request_ids_hash, ''), ':', #{requestIdsHash}), 256) WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
UPDATE material_deletion_proof SET database_purged_at = #{deletedAt}, completed_at = #{deletedAt}, error_free = 1 WHERE material_id = #{materialId}

UPDATE material SET lifecycle_state = 'DELETED', display_name = '[deleted]', latest_version_id = NULL, owner_key = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', owner_key), 256), origin_conversation_id = NULL, last_meaningful_activity_at = NULL, expires_at = NULL, trash_expires_at = NULL, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{materialId} AND lifecycle_generation = #{lifecycleGeneration} AND lifecycle_state = 'DELETING'
